message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to the data read from files or user input; the code directly appends and processes raw DataFrames without any validation.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local files selected via file dialog or hardcoded paths; there are no remote source fetches, and no checksum or integrity verification is performed on any file.
No detected label flipping detection: Labels are hardcoded as 0 (control) and 1 (pseudo) with no validation of label distributions, expected value sets, or label-noise detection tools.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is performed on the loaded data before it is used for training.

No detected model integrity verification: In svm.py, the serialized model is loaded via pickle.load() from a local file path without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision validation.

No detected label distribution validation: The code balances class sizes by taking the minimum of control and pseudo lengths, but performs no explicit label distribution validation, class balance check, or anomaly detection on training samples.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense present in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used anywhere in the pipeline code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any robustness stress-test logic anywhere in the provided code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although KFold splitting separates train and test indices, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, no truly held-out test set isolated before any fitting, and only a single metric (accuracy) is used, so meaningful metric-tampering protection is absent.

No detected input sanitization: No input shape, range, or schema validation is performed on user-supplied file data or the derived kmerData arrays before they are passed to classifiers; only a raw int() conversion is done during parsing.
No detected output bounds checks: No checks on model prediction outputs (e.g., probability bounds, NaN guards, or threshold validation) are present anywhere in the visible inference code path.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses classical ML models (SVM, KNN, CNN, etc.) and is not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
